usage: Recorded-clock sensitivity only; later independent capture still required.

officialContract.semantics: Engine-routed allOrNone fills every requested leg fully within its limit or rejects the request without executions or resting remainders.

controls: Optional age threshold uses the latest owned-side buy receipt clock; the default stays passive.
Only already owned, unpledged shares are eligible. Unknown old maker sales require cancellation-window coverage before replacement.
Bid-side sale must cover worst owned basis and both modeled unit fees; no forced loss.
A later fresh book must follow modeled latency and arrive within the ten-source-second confirmation window.
The entire requested quantity must fit eligible depth; same-side/engine-sequence capacity cannot be reused.
Each one-leg AON gets a separately paced simulated write; maker and AON intents never share an assumed request.
Execution value is the limit-price lower bound, not an asserted actual match price.
AON simulations are excluded from the original strict-print profit signal.
limitations: Book-based fills are counterfactual, not official exchange acknowledgments.
Public depth does not establish account self-trade exclusions or actual writer authority.
Zero modeled fees remain an assumption for this experiment.
The replay freed principal but added no realized profit.
